changelog: The entered L/W/H are now treated as OUTER dimensions: external volume = entered L*W*H, internal volume is derived by subtracting 2x panel thickness from each dimension (e.g. outer 4.2x3.2x2.4 with 150 mm panels -> internal ~3.9x2.9x2.1 = 23.8 m3)

The volume check still compares the internal volume against each machine's max applicable volume (unchanged from earlier versions), now shown with two decimals and on the same basis for single and multi-unit options
Results show both external and internal volumes (with dimension details) and the difference; a red warning appears if outer dims minus panels go <= 0
Export report now labels the dimension row as outer dimensions, with internal volume derived accordingly
Effective storage volume and tonnage still use the derived internal net dimensions
note: PRIMST Cold Room Cooling Load Calculator - English edition. pageVersion triggers live page update; apkVersion/apkUrl trigger the APK update prompt.
